_comment: Known false-positive bans. 'pairs': surface (ar_norm, he_norm) bans (dropped in _ensure_pair); 'roots': (ar_root, he_root) correspondence bans (never seed a root family, and drop candidate pairs with those selected tags); 'edges': (word, 'lang:word') etymology-edge deletions from the borrow graph, applied before the shared-source layer. Confirmed true correspondences (the inverse curation) live in true-positives.json.
_qalb_note: Arabic qalb 'heart' is not cognate with the Hebrew lev/levav family. Two leaks need different bans: (1) qalb's etymology only MENTIONS Proto-Semitic *libb- for comparison but it was ingested as a real borrow edge, so qalb and everything transitively reaching *libb- through it got paired with the lev family via the shared-source layer -- the 'edge' deletion kills all of those (the 'root' ban is belt-and-braces for root families); (2) qalaba/qullab 'to turn' (rootless in kaikki) also carry a direct cog reference to lev -- a surface leak the edge can't reach, so the 'pairs' bans stay.
